article.body_preview:
DHAKA, April 5 (Xinhua) -- Inflation in Bangladesh jumped to 9.33 percent in March mainly due to higher consumer prices in the country, the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS) reported Tuesday.

Data showed month-on-month inflation in Bangladesh increased by 1.13 percent in March over February.

In March, the food inflation rocketed to 9.09 percent from 8.13 percent a month ago, while non-food inflation was 9.72 percent compared with 9.82 percent in February.
